name: Nakagawa (Nagano, Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Nakagawa village emblem in white: a ring divided by a vertical bar with a pointed top, like the character 中.
history: Municipal flag of Nakagawa, a village in Nagano Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 2 March 1959.

features.role: Nakagawa village emblem — a ring divided by a vertical bar with a pointed top, like the character 中
